question: Please calculate the growth rates for Asians, Black people, Latinx people, Native Americans, White people, US women, US men, global women, and global men from 2014 to 2024 concerning the overall workforce.
sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT 
    workforce,
    report_year,
    race_asian,
    race_black,
    race_hispanic_latinx,
    race_native_american,
    race_white,
    gender_us_women,
    gender_us_men,
    gender_global_women,
    gender_global_men
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_dei.dar_non_intersectional_representation`
  WHERE workforce = 'overall'
),
y2014 AS (
  SELECT * FROM base WHERE report_year = 2014
),
y2022 AS (
  SELECT * FROM base WHERE report_year = 2022
)
SELECT 
  'Asian' AS demographic_group,
  y2022.race_asian - y2014.race_asian AS growth_rate
FROM y2014, y2022
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'Black' AS demographic_group,
  y2022.race_black - y2014.race_black AS growth_rate
FROM y2014, y2022
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'Latinx' AS demographic_group,
  y2022.race_hispanic_latinx - y2014.race_hispanic_latinx AS growth_rate
FROM y2014, y2022
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'Native American' AS demographic_group,
  y2022.race_native_american - y2014.race_native_american AS growth_rate
FROM y2014, y2022
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'White' AS demographic_group,
  y2022.race_white - y2014.race_white AS growth_rate
FROM y2014, y2022
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'US women' AS demographic_group,
  y2022.gender_us_women - y2014.gender_us_women AS growth_rate
FROM y2014, y2022
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'US men' AS demographic_group,
  y2022.gender_us_men - y2014.gender_us_men AS growth_rate
FROM y2014, y2022
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'Global women' AS demographic_group,
  y2022.gender_global_women - y2014.gender_global_women AS growth_rate
FROM y2014, y2022
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'Global men' AS demographic_group,
  y2022.gender_global_men - y2014.gender_global_men AS growth_rate
FROM y2014, y2022
